attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id
FROM code.calls
WHERE callee_symbol_id = 'Client._send_single_request'
  AND caller_symbol_id != 'Client._send_single_request'
  AND callee_name = '_send_single_request'
  AND caller_symbol_id IN (
    SELECT symbol_id
    FROM code.symbols
    WHERE file_id IN (
      SELECT file_id
      FROM code.files
      WHERE module = '_client'
    )
  )
ORDER BY caller_symbol_id;
